$comment: THE PROBLEM SET FOR scripts/atlas-eval.mjs — every question and every expectation here is DERIVED FROM A RECORD, never invented.
A question is here only if its text was recorded (DEV-NOTES.md or the round's own checks). An expectation is here only if the round
that asked the question JUDGED by it. A criterion the record does not supply is left out and its absence is explained in `unset` —
an empty expectation is an honest 'the record does not say', a guessed one is a false alarm or a false pass waiting to happen.
Field meanings: scripts/atlas-eval/judge.mjs (the only reader). The schema is enforced by tests/atlas-eval-harness-checks.test.mjs.

R802.recorded: 11 of the 46 texts are recorded (10 in full, 1 elided with 「…」). The other 35 exist only as their findings (the Nile turn of 10 m 34 s, the five Syria turns, the typhoon Dujuan / Lake Baikal / U.S. Antarctic Program replies, the 「条約上の位置」 heading, the German reply) — the record carries no question text for them, so they cannot be asked again without inventing one.
R802.leftOver: R802 §0 names 12 more questions still to be asked (the request was 'at least 50'); their texts were never written down.

R775.recorded: 6 texts are recorded (§1, §4 table, §6b, §7). The rest exist only as findings (the volcano turn of 5 m 32 s, the Korean Peninsula geocode miss).

unset.replyMustNotMatch: R802 judged this turn by its zero operations; it did not record what a correct duration or distance is.

questions.text: 世界の原子力発電所を地図に表示して、日本のものだけ強調して。

questions.text: Compare the population density of Tokyo, Delhi and Lagos

resultMustNotMatch.pattern: No readable data on the active layers here

questions.text: いま太平洋上を飛んでいる旅客機を…最も高度が高いものを教えて
questions.whyNotSendable: DEV-NOTES.md R802 §4 elides the middle of the question with 「…」. Filling it in would be asking a question nobody asked; it is kept so the finding and its criterion are not lost.

recordedDefect.note: the aviation layer was painted, then 「便名：確認不能／現在高度：確認不能」

replyMustNotMatch.why: R802 §4: the reader was told flight and altitude could not be confirmed while the layer was drawn

resultMustNotMatch.pattern: Turn a data layer on first

unset.replyMustMatch: R802 did not record which satellites were overhead.

questions.text: Show global earthquakes of magnitude 5 or greater in the last 7 days

recordedDefect.note: the layer went on with neither the magnitude filter nor a list

unset.map: R802 says 'no filter and no list'; it did not record what a filtered layer looks like in the snapshot, or how many events a correct list has.
unset.reach: R802 did not name the capability that should have filtered.

questions.text: Show the top 10 countries by GDP per capita as a choropleth, and tell me which of them are NOT in the top 10 by total GDP.

recordedDefect.reply: I'm comparing the two rankings now.
recordedDefect.note: both tables and the choropleth were drawn; the asked comparison was never stated

replyMustNotMatch.why: R802 §8: this narration was the whole reply the reader received — the answer was never written

unset.replyMustMatch: R802 did not record which countries are the correct answer; deriving them from the bundled data would copy today's ranking rules (isRankableCountry) into this file.
unset.map: R802 recorded that the choropleth WAS drawn; it did not record the snapshot field it judged by.

placeProbes.$comment: R802 §6 measured these through IntMapRouteGeocode.suggest — a path with no animation and NO MODEL CALL, so it costs nothing and needs no login. `mustNot` is the wrong answer R802 recorded, on the field that distinguishes it; `agree` asks that the top name agree with the asked one. `mustResolve` is set only where R802 recorded a resolution after its repair (§6: Sahara, the Alps, Siberia, Patagonia; Tokyo, Iceland, Mount Fuji and Lake Baikal unchanged) — elsewhere 「nothing found」 is the refusal R802 wanted instead of a wrong kind of place, not a failure.

Chicken Story Korean Fried Chicken (Auckland, New Zealand)
